headline: SK Hynix says memory shortages will persist until 2030
quote: shipment volumes for PCs and mobile devices are expected to decrease due to cost burdens from rising memory prices and supply shortages.
claim: SK Hynix expects demand to exceed supply through 2030, and its CFO predicted PC and mobile shipments will fall because of rising memory prices. Quarterly revenue was 104.6 trillion won, up 328 percent year over year.
why_it_matters: RAM and SSD prices for laptops and upgrades are unlikely to ease soon, so buying memory early or choosing fixed configurations matters.
title: SK Hynix says memory shortages to persist until 2030

headline: Apple launches 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro in India from Rs 2,39,900
quote: Apple has launched the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 in India at Rs 2,39,900. Pre-orders begin October 28, with sales starting November 6
claim: The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 starts at Rs 2,39,900 in India with 16GB unified memory and 1TB storage; the 24GB 1TB configuration is Rs 2,63,900. Sales start November 6.
why_it_matters: Even the base M6 Pro-class MacBook with 16GB sits near Jai's Rs 2.5 lakh ceiling; 24GB is already above it.
title: Apple MacBook Pro with M6 launched in India: Check price, offers and specs | Gadgets - Business Standard

headline: TrendForce: high-end MLCC shortage to persist through 1H27 as AI inference lifts DDR5 demand
quote: major notebook ODMs expect orders to decline by an average of 10–15% YoY in 4Q26
claim: TrendForce says notebook ODMs expect orders to fall an average of 10-15% YoY in 4Q26, and high-end MLCC shortages should be worst in 1Q27 and 2Q27 as Vera Rubin ramps.
why_it_matters: Component shortages beyond memory can keep laptop prices firm into 2027.
title: AI Inference Drives CPU and DDR5 Demand, with High-Capacitance MLCC Shortages Expected to Persist Through 1H27, Says TrendForce
